text: The initiative faced significant political and operational disruptions after February 2021, which affected the scale and speed of deploying domestic instruments during major events such as Cyclone Mocha in May 2023. Myanmar's active uptake of SEADRIF insurance products during 2020–2025 was limited or not publicly documented.

Cyclone-related Government Risk Financing in Myanmar, 
Disaster Management Fund (DMF), 
Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Insurance Facility (SEADRIF)
